title: Caregiver in Focus: Legal Dispute and New Training in São José do Rio.
seoTitle: Caregiver in Focus: Legal Dispute & Training in São José
subtitle: Understand the controversy involving Angélica's former caregiver and the offer of free training in the region
excerpt: Interest in caregivers surged after a legal dispute involving Angélica and the announcement of a free elderly caregiver course in São José do Rio Preto.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Prefeitura de São José do Rio Preto (SP), Alô Alô Bahia, Correio Braziliense
contentHtml:
The topic of caregivers has gained prominence in recent weeks due to two distinct news items: a legal dispute between TV host Angélica and a former caregiver for her father, and the opening of registrations for a free elderly caregiver course in São José do Rio Preto. Both events generated intense public interest.

Legal Controversy Involving Angélica's Former Caregiver

In the labor lawsuit filed by the former caregiver of Angélica's father, the professional is claiming R$ 191,674.18 in labor rights. The TV host's defense requested the judge to apply a 5% fine on the updated value of the case, which amounts to approximately R$ 9.6 thousand. The request for a penalty is based on an allegation of bad-faith litigation, despite there being no judicial decision recognizing such conduct.

Request for Fine and Admission of Guilt

The judge had already applied the penalty of confession, which allows the facts presented by the opposing party to be considered true, within procedural limits. The former caregiver, identified by the initials J. C., presented a medical certificate to justify his absence from a hearing and requested a new date without penalties. Angélica's defense contested the justification, pointing out a discrepancy between the time of the hearing and the recorded medical appointment.

Free Elderly Caregiver Course in São José do Rio Preto

Concurrently, the Liga Riopretense de Inclusão e Apoio Social, in partnership with the City Hall of São José do Rio Preto and the Municipal Secretariat of Labor and Employment, opened pre-registrations for a new class of the free elderly caregiver course. There are 39 vacancies, with an anticipated start on November 9, 2026, and an end date of January 11, 2027.

Training Details

The program includes 40 classes, totaling 160 hours of coursework, and will be held Monday to Friday, from 8 AM to 12 PM, at Rua Antônio de Godoy, 6010, Nova Redentora. To register, applicants must be over 18 years old and have a monthly income of up to R$ 4,863 or be without income. Pre-registrations remain open until November 6, 2026.

Alignment with Sustainable Development Goals

This training initiative is linked to items 4, 8, and 10 of the UN's 2030 Agenda: Quality Education, Decent Work and Economic Growth, and Reduced Inequalities. The project aims to expand qualification and job market insertion opportunities for people in situations of economic vulnerability.

How to Participate in the Selection

Interested parties can register in person during the service hours of the Municipal Secretariat of Labor and Employment, or contact via WhatsApp at (17) 99773-7125. The selection process follows age and income criteria, as described in the public notice.

With information from Prefeitura de São José do Rio Preto (SP), Alô Alô Bahia, Correio Braziliense.
